An '''unidentified alien''' is the elder of [[Unidentified raider group|a group]], who lived on an [[Unidentified desert world|unidentified world]] near a location known as [[Cipher Canyon]]. They were mistaken as raiders by local settlers, though in reality they were simply attempting to protect their local resources from being taken without permission. They fought with [[Asajj Ventress]], [[Lyco Strata]], and a [[Unidentified granddaughter|young girl]] encountered this group when attempted to gather [[water]] from the canyon, briefly went into conflict before agreed to make peace with they and the girl's [[Unidentified grandfather (Asajj Ventress)|grandfather]] who lived nearby.<ref name="Warrior" />
